newsitem.title: CANADA: TLC to buy 20/20 Laser Centers for $25 mln.
newsitem.headline: TLC to buy 20/20 Laser Centers for $25 mln.

text.p: TLC Laser Center Inc said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire all of the outstanding shares of 20/20 Laser Centers Inc for about US$25 million.
The Toronto-based laser surgery company said the deal is expected to close on or before January 31 next year subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
TLC said it will fund the takeover by issuing US$33 million worth of shares at a price of C$7.25 a share.
